verdicts.reason: A and B look pixel-identical in this 320x50 strip, so neither is better. Both have the same flaws: the CITRINE wordmark sits below the headline, which reverses the brand-then-headline order; the Find a Store pill is jammed against the bottom edge and crowds the wordmark; the product bag is a tiny unreadable thumbnail on the right; and the cropped decorative circles look like smudges, leaving the left side empty and lopsided.
